LESSON: KUANDIKA 1.3.1 VIAKIFISHI KUBWA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
2. kueleza matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
3. kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa.
4. Show that you can: kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi kubwa important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
2. kueleza matumizi ya herufi kubwa na kikomo katika matini
3. kutumia herufi kubwa na kikomo ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
